context: A Kansai friend rants about a TV show with his girlfriend
purpose: Teach: まとも/ヤツ/アレ/こいつ/トーク/いい加減/どうせ/カン

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: なあ聞いてや、昨日のあのトーク番組、まじでまともちゃうかってん。
lines.en: Hey listen, that talk show yesterday was seriously not normal.
lines.style: Kansai dialect, casual venting tone, exasperated and animated delivery

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、また?どうせまた司会のあの人の話やろ?
lines.en: Aw, again? I bet it's about that host guy again, right?
lines.style: Soft warm voice, gently teasing, affectionate familiarity with partner

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そうやねん!あのヤツ、ゲストの話遮ってばっかりで、もういい加減にしてほしいわ。
lines.en: Exactly! That guy keeps cutting off the guests, give it a rest already.
lines.style: Kansai dialect, rising frustration, complaining loudly with hand gestures

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、でも前は面白いって言うてたやん、こいつ気分屋やなぁ。
lines.en: Hehe, but you used to say he was funny, you're so moody.
lines.style: Playful gentle laughter, mildly teasing back, warm intimate tone

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ちゃうねん、最近のアレはほんま酷いって。俺のカン、当たってるから見とき。
lines.en: No really, his recent stuff is awful. Trust my gut, just watch.
lines.style: Kansai dialect, insistent and confident, leaning forward defensively

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はいはい、ダイちゃんのカン信じとくわ。じゃあもう見るのやめたら?
lines.en: Sure sure, I'll trust your intuition. Then just stop watching it?
lines.style: Affectionate sigh, indulgent girlfriend voice, soft suggestion tone

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: それがな、どうせ来週も見てまうねん…自分でもアホやと思うわ。
lines.en: The thing is, I'll probably watch next week too, I know I'm dumb.
lines.style: Kansai dialect, sheepish admission, deflated chuckle at himself

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: やっぱりな。じゃあ一緒に見て一緒に文句言お?その方が楽しいやん。
lines.en: Knew it. Then let's watch and complain together, more fun that way.
lines.style: Warm loving suggestion, smiling voice, drawing closer affectionately
